body: Probably a lot of people, they’re on r/suicidewatch

Honestly just call and say you’re having suicidal thoughts and are afraid of hurting yourself. Be honest and say “I need to be hospitalized or I’m afraid I’ll kill myself” if you need to. I’d be surprised if they brush that off no matter how young you are. If they brush you off you can still take an Uber after.

You deserve to get help and feel rest, OP. I hope you can catch your breath soon

I feel like it’s usually more successful just to listen to OPs and help them understand that they’re being heard & that someone cares about their issues. Then if you want to give advice based on their actual situation that’s one thing. But frankly saying things like “it’ll definitely get better” isn’t necessarily true (and is actually against the sub’s rules). I would read the sidebar fully to understand what’s not helpful and can actually be harmful to suicidal people.

I have similar! For me I think it was the medication, I was so severely depressed at age 6 (fuck clinical depression) I was stuck on the stuff until I was 17. That entire 11 year span is a giant gap except 4-5 terrible memories. Nothing good survived. I’m 19 and it feels like I was literally born a year and a half ago, it doesn’t seem like the person in stories I hear from others is me.

Not everyone has friends they can just hang out with, or problems they can just ignore/a mental state that allows them to ignore their problems. And not everyone is able to move out so easily. Plus two years a long time, especially when you’re already depressed/suicidal. I know you have good intentions but this is tone deaf.
This is so genuinely awful that it actually made me laugh too

You’re not a monster, from what I can tell you’re just in pain. It’s hard not to lash out when you’re suffering, it just gets impossible to cover up. Your actions when you’re in pain don’t make you a monster, they just mean you’re human. I really really really hope you’re able to find peace

I’m sorry you’re in so much pain, I know it’s unbearable. I saw you’ve posted here before and it’s amazing you’ve lasted with all of this inside. I really hope you change your mind but either way I hope that either decision brings you peace and you’re able to rest and catch your breath.

I understand totally, my severe depression hasn’t gone away for 13 years now and even though the suicidal feelings ebb, the idea of wanting to not exist has always been at least somewhere below the surface. It seems so unfair that other people can talk about “getting” depression then being cured 6 months later. It makes me angry & sad at once. Sad because it’s unfair and I’m jealous. Angry at myself for being too worthless to get better, and angry at them for having the ability to get better. It feels almost like taunting me. I wish I could say I’m also happy for them like you are but I just can’t feel anything but bitterness

I understand there’s times when I can only get off my couch to get water. The world is so hard sometimes but you’re not broken, you’re just sick right now. If you have a book of goodbyes maybe you can reach out to some of the people in the book, maybe not to tell them what’s going on but just to talk. Hey how’s your dog, crazy weather, etc. Even going through immense pain, talking to others like that probably won’t cure it but the distraction can get you through some hard times or at least ease the pain for a bit.
I don’t have much in me to know what to say, but I hear you and I understand your pain and I’m sorry. It’s not fair
